first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A child riding Vehicle A with their back to the camera, with neck-length short brown hair, wearing a red long-sleeved top and dark blue overalls.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: The low children's tricycle ridden by Person A, with a blue high backrest, red lower structure, two wide black rear wheels, and part of a curved metal handlebar visible.

entities.name: orange-brown geometric-patterned carpet
entities.identification: The carpet continuously covering the corridor floor, with a thick orange zigzag corner frame, dark brown areas, and a red central block.

entities.name: interior wall
entities.identification: The light beige walls on both sides of the corridor, with vertical wall corners and dark brown baseboards.

entities.name: interior door
entities.identification: The set of dark brown doors on both sides and at the end of the corridor, with narrow dark doorframes and partially visible bright-colored door handles.

entities.name: ceiling
entities.identification: The light-colored ceiling above the corridor, with visible transverse projecting sections and edge molding.

entities.name: interior ceiling light
entities.identification: The set of white, round-shaded light fixtures mounted on the corridor ceiling.

entities.name: interior framed picture
entities.identification: The vertically oriented rectangular framed picture high on the right-side wall, with a light-colored image area and a thin, narrow dark frame.

entities.name: potted plant at the end of the corridor
entities.identification: The potted plant on the image-left side of the far door, with a terracotta-colored portion of the pot and a small amount of dark green foliage exposed; most of it is occluded by Person A.

entities.name: red wall plate at the end of the corridor
entities.identification: The red circular wall-mounted objects arranged vertically on the image-left side of the far door; the upper one has a larger visible outline.
